boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 97 stacks two horizontal frames packed with colored blocks. The upper frame holds a yellow block, blue borders, large red blocks, and padlocked orange/yellow pieces (padlock `5`). The lower frame is twice as dense with large red and green blocks, blue, orange, purple, and padlocked yellow pieces. Work both frames in alternation — clear non-padlocked edge blocks to unlock the padlock `5` gates in each frame, then feed the large pieces through.
landmarks: Block Out Level 97 stacks two horizontal frames packed with colored blocks.
The upper frame holds a yellow block, blue borders, large red blocks, and padlocked orange/yellow pieces (padlock `5`).
The lower frame is twice as dense with large red and green blocks, blue, orange, purple, and padlocked yellow pieces.
Work both frames in alternation — clear non-padlocked edge blocks to unlock the padlock `5` gates in each frame, then feed the large pieces through.

quickTips: Padlock `5` counters are per-frame — clearing upper blocks only unlocks upper padlocks, not lower ones.
Start with the non-padlocked edge blocks in both frames to build toward the five-clear unlock threshold.
Feed the large green block in the lower center last — it blocks the center path and needs the most room.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Upper frame: slide the blue border block on the far right through the right-wall exit, then push the yellow block on the far left through the left-wall exit (02:24–02:20 in the video).

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Lower frame: clear the orange and purple blocks on the far right through the right-wall exit — they are closest and not padlocked (02:20–02:15).

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Upper frame: clear the large red blocks in the center-left through the left-wall exit — each removal counts toward the upper padlock `5` unlock (02:15–02:06).

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Upper frame padlocks now open: clear the orange and yellow padlocked blocks from the center through the right exit (02:06).

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Lower frame: clear non-padlocked blue and red blocks from the center to count toward the lower padlock `5` threshold (02:01–01:52).

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Lower frame padlocks now open: clear the yellow padlocked blocks on the far left through the left-wall exit (01:52).

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Feed the large green block in the lower center through the bottom exit — it takes several passes and needs the center path clear (01:47–01:38).

steps.title: Move 8
steps.instruction: Finish with the remaining small blocks from both frames through the nearest exits (01:38–01:33).

failurePoints: Clearing red blocks in the upper frame before planning the padlocked blocks' exit route — once the surrounding space fills with lower-frame spill, the padlocked blocks have nowhere to go.
Treating the padlock counters as shared — clearing five upper-frame blocks does not unlock lower-frame padlocks, so working only one frame at a time wastes moves.
